segments.sn22.150:1.2: “Kismiṃ nu kho, bhikkhave, sati, kiṃ upādāya uppajjati ajjhattaṃ sukhadukkhan”ti?
segments.sn22.150:1.3: Bhagavaṃmūlakā no, bhante, dhammā … pe …“rūpe kho, bhikkhave, sati rūpaṃ upādāya uppajjati ajjhattaṃ sukhadukkhaṃ.
segments.sn22.150:1.5: Vedanāya sati … pe … saññāya sati … saṅkhāresu sati … viññāṇe sati viññāṇaṃ upādāya uppajjati ajjhattaṃ sukhadukkhaṃ.
segments.sn22.150:1.9: Taṃ kiṃ maññatha, bhikkhave, rūpaṃ niccaṃ vā aniccaṃ vā”ti?
segments.sn22.150:1.12: “Yaṃ panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vā taṃ sukhaṃ vā”ti?
segments.sn22.150:1.14: “Yaṃ panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vipariṇāmadhammaṃ, api nu taṃ anupādāya uppajjeyya ajjhattaṃ sukhadukkhan”ti?
segments.sn22.150:1.16: “Vedanā … pe … saññā … saṅkhārā … viññāṇaṃ niccaṃ vā aniccaṃ vā”ti?
segments.sn22.150:1.21: “Yaṃ panāniccaṃ, dukkhaṃ vā taṃ sukhaṃ vā”ti?
segments.sn22.150:1.23: “Yaṃ panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vipariṇāmadhammaṃ, api nu taṃ anupādāya uppajjeyya ajjhattaṃ sukhadukkhan”ti?

lines: Dutiye kiṃ abhinivissāti kiṃ abhinivisitvā, paccayaṃ katvāti attho.
